```{r}

```

```{r}
str(bc)
head(bc)
head(bc)

colSums(is.na(bc))

```

```{r}
bc$diagnosis <- as.factor(bc$diagnosis)
```

```{r}
summary(bc$texture_mean)

ggplot(bc, aes(x = diagnosis, y = texture_mean)) + geom_boxplot(fill = "skyblue") +
  labs(title = "Histogram of Texture_mean", x = "Diagnosis classification", y = "Texture_mean") + 
  theme_minimal()

```
